test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Active community involvement __________ a sense of belonging and contributes to the overall well-being of society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fosters"** means to encourage or promote the development or growth of something. (पोषण करना, बढ़ावा देना)

 
 
• **Example:** A good teacher fosters creativity and curiosity in their students.
 
 
 
• The word **"fosters"** aligns perfectly with the context of the sentence, as active community involvement helps in creating a sense of belonging and contributes to overall societal well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (fosters)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Collects** (संग्रह करना): To gather or bring together.

 
 
• **Example:** He collects stamps from different countries.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Forgets** (भूल जाना): To lose memory of something or fail to recall.
 
 
• **Example:** She often forgets where she keeps her keys.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Fails** (असफल होना): To not succeed in achieving a goal.
 
 
• **Example:** He fails to meet the expectations set by his team.
